entrypoint.configuration: Opaque LocalConfiguration constructed only from reviewed local guardian path/hash, worker path/hash and absolute DB locator. Not an MCP/Telegram tool. Configuration is trusted cooperative local code, not IAM or authority.
entrypoint.success: Body transport evidence only; consumer strict codec must validate response and canonical effect fences remain separate.

wire.request: One nonempty unsigned big-endian32 byte length plus exact body<=1048572. Guardian independently bounds and reads frame, forwards through dedicated stdin pipe while draining output, then closes worker stdin. Parent port need not send EOF.
wire.response: One nonempty unsigned big-endian32 byte length plus body<=1048572, no trailing bytes. Total output<=1048576. Worker must exit0; FFI also verifies UTF8 and success arrived before call deadline.
wire.deadline: Caller monotonic deadline begins before helper/config verification. Guardian receives remaining budget; input/spawn/output/exit all share its monotonic one-shot deadline. Successful response after original5000ms is refused. Guardian cleanup separately bounds waitpid to500ms; outer5700ms watchdog returns CleanupUnknown, not quiescence.
wire.cleanup: Terminate process group while child PID remains unreaped; reap owned direct child. Pump observes leader exit even if descendant inherited stdout. Parent death closes owned port and guardian observes parent EOF. No automatic retry.
wire.errors: Finite fixed redacted codes; worker stderr discarded, error outputs not reflected.
wire.configuration: Pinned compiled worker/guardian SHA256 and regular single-link executable bounds rechecked each call. DB locator passed only from configuration; DB safety/schema/durability checks belong to storage worker. No runtime compiler or package lookup.

limitations: Independent source review and actual AGY native-store protocol integration still required; tests use compiled EOF-sensitive fixture and no database writes.

Transport does not validate JSON duplicate keys/canonical domain encoding; native storage worker and Gleam domain codec must do so. Test maximum body is valid UTF8 transport data, not an admitted JSON operation.
No production runtime release, task/coordinator mutation, consumer integration, Telegram traffic or automatic retry.
Cooperative same-UID configuration and executable pathname checks are not hostile filesystem isolation. Immutable release/service cgroup and real effect-time authority remain required.
Descendants deliberately creating a new session escape process-group containment and require service cgroup; guardian only reaps its direct child. CleanupUnknown never establishes quiescence.
Physical storage quota and power-loss durability are outside transport evidence.
